name: pscode-ai
description: Local-first AI agent built into PSCode: chat, inline edit and an agentic tool loop.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Chat has no tools and cannot touch your workspace, so it answers questions in Restricted Mode. Agent mode stays off because it can run commands, and AGENTS.md rules and the @codebase index stay off because they read the folder into the model's prompt. Trust the folder to enable them.

commands.title: PSCode: Restore Checkpoint (undo an agent turn)

enumDescriptions: The engine and weights that ship with PSCode. Starts with the window, stops with it, needs nothing installed.
A local Ollama server you run yourself
Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint (llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI, OpenRouter)
pscode.ai.provider.description: Which backend PSCode AI talks to. "bundled" needs no setup; the others expect a server you provide.

pscode.ai.endpoint.description: Base URL of the model server. Leave empty to use the provider default; ignored by "bundled", which starts its own engine on a free port.

pscode.ai.model.description: Model identifier for chat, inline edit and the agent. Ignored by the "bundled" provider, which uses the weights it shipped with. Tool calling is required for Agent mode.

pscode.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key, only needed for hosted providers. Leave empty for local models. Prefer setting `PSCODE_API_KEY` in your environment instead of storing a key in settings.

pscode.ai.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower is more deterministic, which suits code edits.

pscode.ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate per response.

pscode.ai.contextSize.description: Context window for the bundled engine, in tokens. Larger costs memory and slows the first token; agent turns need more room than chat.

pscode.ai.threads.description: CPU threads for the bundled engine. 0 picks one fewer than your core count, leaving a core for the editor.

pscode.ai.startupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the bundled engine to load its weights before reporting a failure. Loading 9GB takes ~21s once the file is in the page cache; this is set for a first run reading it off disk.

pscode.ai.requestTimeoutMs.description: Abort a request after this many milliseconds of silence. It is an inactivity timeout, so what it really bounds is the wait for the first token - once tokens stream, the gaps are small. Measured on the bundled 14B: a plain question is ~61s to first token, an agent turn carrying all 11 tool definitions took 440s. A 5-minute default cut that off mid-prefill and surfaced as a timeout on a model that was working.

pscode.ai.contextBudgetChars.description: Approximate character budget for file context sent to the model. Lower this if your model has a small context window.

pscode.agent.enabled.description: Allow Agent mode, where the model can call tools to read and edit files and run commands.

pscode.agent.maxIterations.description: Maximum tool-call rounds before the agent loop stops.

pscode.agent.approveShellCommands.description: Ask for confirmation before the agent runs a terminal command. Turning this off lets the model run commands unattended.

pscode.agent.approveFileWrites.description: Ask for confirmation before the agent writes to a file.

pscode.ai.projectRules.description: Send the repository's own conventions to the model. Reads the first of .pscoderules, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules or .github/copilot-instructions.md found in each workspace folder.

pscode.ai.embeddingModel.description: Embedding model for @codebase. Ignored by the "bundled" provider, which uses the embedding weights it shipped with.

pscode.ai.semanticInclude.description: Glob of files to include in the semantic index. Source files only by default; indexing lock files and bundles makes results worse, not better.

pscode.ai.semanticExclude.description: Glob of files to exclude from the semantic index.

pscode.ai.semanticMaxFiles.description: Hard cap on files indexed for @codebase. Indexing runs on the CPU, so this bounds how long a build can take.

pscode.ai.semanticMaxHits.description: How many semantic matches to send to the model. Each one costs context budget.

pscode.ai.semanticAutoUpdate.description: Re-embed a file when you save it, so @codebase stays current between full index builds. Only ever updates an index that already exists - it never starts one for you.
